question: To which revilers must the kaula teaching never be given?
premises: A reviler of Shiva is excluded
A slanderer of Kula Bhairava is excluded
The prohibition is addressed to the goddess
inference: The teaching must not be given to one who reviles Shiva or slanders Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may qualify nindake or stand separately
plain_english: O goddess, not to one who reviles Shiva, nor to a slanderer of Kula Bhairava.
